caption: A stone is dropped into a still garden pond; it splashes, sinks, and ripples spread out across the water.

sa.check: A stone is dropped into a still pond.
Ripples spread out across the water.
The pond is still before the drop.
The splash comes first, then the sinking, then the ripples spread.

pc.expect: The splash rises at the moment of entry and falls back, and the water closes over the stone.
pc.fail: There is no splash when the stone enters; or the splash hangs in the air; or the water stays rigid like glass.

pc.expect: Rings spread outward from the entry point and fade as they widen.
pc.fail: Rings run inward; or they appear before the stone lands; or they stop dead and hold their shape.

pc.expect: The stone goes under and stays under.
pc.fail: The stone floats; or it comes back up; or it hangs at the surface.

pc.expect: Away from the ripples the water stays still.
pc.fail: Waves appear elsewhere with no cause; or the surface churns before the stone lands; or the centre of the rings moves.

pc.expect: One stone enters and nothing else appears in the water.
pc.fail: The stone vanishes in mid-air or a second appears; or it turns into another object; or a splash appears where nothing landed.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pond's colour and the garden around it stay the same.
pc.fail: The water changes colour; or the plants rearrange; or the pond's edge moves.
